protocol: Existing reconstructed intermediate states, archived original final choices, and archived random-search scores
success_metric: Fraction of the same 70 runs whose current chosen complete label sequence exactly matches its reference
accuracy_metric: Mean current operation-label accuracy across the same 70 runs
selection: Latest valid model-labelled candidate; original full outputs take precedence; no truth-based best selection
error_rule: Carry latest valid candidate after invalid calls; zero until one exists
termination: Use original final snapshot at terminal attempt and carry it to later budgets
provenance_limit: Some intermediate states differ in offline replay. They are reconstructed previews, not verified original trajectories.
